mapper.sql: slot_code, usable_height, fork_height, destination_x, destination_y, destination_heading, status, reserved_task_id, stored_cargo_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO storage_slot (slot_code, usable_height, fork_height, destination_x, destination_y, destination_heading, status, reserved_task_id, stored_cargo_id) VALUES (#{slotCode}, #{usableHeight}, #{forkHeight}, #{destinationX}, #{destinationY}, #{destinationHeading}, #{status}, #{reservedTaskId}, #{storedCargoId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM storage_slot ORDER BY slot_code
SELECT slot_code, usable_height, fork_height, destination_x, destination_y, destination_heading, status FROM storage_slot WHERE status = 'EMPTY' ORDER BY slot_code
mapper.update: UPDATE storage_slot SET status='RESERVED', reserved_task_id=#{reservedTaskId} WHERE slot_code=#{slotCode} AND status='EMPTY'
UPDATE storage_slot SET status='EMPTY', reserved_task_id=NULL, stored_cargo_id=NULL WHERE slot_code=#{slotCode} AND status='RESERVED' AND reserved_task_id=#{reservedTaskId}
